roles.merlin: An old wise wizard with a long silver beard and a deep blue hooded robe, holding a wooden staff with a softly glowing crystal, calm knowing eyes, as if he is keeping a secret.
roles.percival: A young knight with a straw blond bowl cut fringe straight across his forehead, a short moustache and a neat chin beard, pale blue green eyes, a small healing cut on his cheek, a stern watchful expression, dark leather and steel armour with a raised collar and a dark red cloak, a clear blue sky behind him.
roles.loyal-servant: A rugged battle worn knight in his thirties, close portrait from the chest up, wearing a rounded open faced steel helmet in the Norse viking style with a riveted brow band and nose guard, dark hair showing under it, short stubble, a thin streak of blood on his cheek, weary determined eyes looking into the distance. Dented plate armour with a round engraved brooch and a heavy deep blue cloak over one shoulder. Behind him a cold dusk sky with orange light on the clouds and a distant castle on a hill.
roles.loyal-servant-2: A young battle worn knight in his late twenties, head and shoulders, long dark curly hair falling to his shoulders, short dark stubble, a fresh cut on his cheekbone, intense steady eyes looking at the viewer, dented steel plate armour with a raised collar, a soft blue dusk sky behind him.
roles.loyal-servant-3: A noble young woman of Arthur's court in three quarter view, brown hair swept back and pinned, a thin gold headband across her forehead, calm clear grey blue eyes, a deep blue gown with a string of pearls at the neckline, soft light on her face, a hazy blue sky behind her.
roles.loyal-servant-4: A woman knight, close portrait, wearing a polished steel helmet with a rounded crest and a nose guard that frames her face, strong brows, piercing blue eyes looking at the viewer, a polished steel gorget and plate armour with blue enamelled scale shoulder plates, a bright blue sky behind her.
roles.assassin: A female assassin, close portrait, wearing a deep crimson hood with long dark red hair spilling out, holding a blood stained dagger upright in front of her face so the blade hides half of it, one pale almost white eye staring coldly at the viewer past the blade, a few drops of blood on her fingers. Swirling red cloth and glowing embers around her, black and crimson palette, menacing and beautiful.
roles.morgana: A dark enchantress in three quarter profile, long wavy copper orange hair falling past her shoulders, a slim gold headband across her brow set with a large faceted red ruby at the centre of her forehead, a tall ribbed gold collar around her neck, pale skin, dark kohl rimmed eyes with a cold sideways stare, warm golden candle light on one side of her face, deep brown shadow behind her.
roles.mordred: A dark prince with an ashen grey demonic face, close portrait, gaunt sharp features, dark shadowed eye sockets with a faint red glow, grey cracked skin, long tangled black hair, wearing a black hood and a jagged spiked iron crown, head tilted slightly back with a cold proud expression. Black armour and cloak, red hellish glow and smoke behind him, sinister and regal.
roles.oberon: A lone fey creature, close portrait, sallow yellow green skin, a crest of sharp thorn like spikes rising from the top of his head, curved horns, long pointed ears, a snarling open mouth with sharp fangs, a few dark drops on his chin, burning dark eyes, bare shoulders, a warm amber glow against a dark brown background.
roles.card-back: The back design of a playing card, portrait orientation, filling the whole frame edge to edge. Abstract ornamental pattern only: a perfectly symmetrical medieval crest at the centre made of a round table seen from directly above with a single upright sword through a small crown, surrounded by fine filigree and a repeating knot border. Mirrored top to bottom and left to right. Deep ink blue background with antique gold line work, slightly worn painted texture, dark vignette at the edges. Absolutely no people, no faces, no figures, no characters, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark. Original design, not based on any existing game.

badges.shared: A single round enamel medal badge for a fantasy card game, seen straight on, perfectly centred and filling most of the square, with the whole badge including its outer points fully visible and a margin around it. Highly detailed jewellery craftsmanship, polished metal and glossy enamel, crisp engraved details, soft studio lighting, subtle shadow under the badge. Isolated on a plain pure white background. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark. Original design, not based on any existing game, film or brand.
badges.blue: The loyal side badge. A deep royal blue enamel field framed by a thick polished gold ring engraved with a repeating laurel leaf and small rune-like notches, and eight slender gold rays pointing outward from behind the ring. In the centre a rearing winged horse, a pegasus, in gold and pale silver with its wings raised, holding a long spear upright in front of its body. Gold and blue colour scheme.
badges.red: The evil side badge. A deep crimson enamel field framed by a thick dark polished steel ring engraved with a repeating row of small teeth and fine filigree, and eight sharp steel points radiating outward from behind the ring. In the centre a two headed eagle in silver and dark steel, the two heads turned in opposite directions with open beaks, both wings spread wide open, both legs spread wide apart with the claws open. Crimson and steel colour scheme.

props.shared: Original artwork for the face of a playing card in a fantasy board game, portrait orientation, filling the whole frame edge to edge with no card border and no frame drawn. Rich painterly realism, Arthurian dark fantasy mood, soft cinematic light, fine surface detail. Absolutely no text, no letters, no words, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no emblems or badges. Original design, not based on any existing game, film, artist or brand.
props.approve: The face of the APPROVE vote card. Background: warm cream parchment card stock with a subtle soft stone texture and a gentle darker vignette toward the edges, lit by warm light from the upper left. The upper third of the card is calm and plain, left empty for a title to be added later. In the lower two thirds, centred: one perfectly round, polished white marble sphere with faint pale grey and soft gold veins and a glossy highlight, resting on the card and casting a soft shadow beneath it. Quiet, noble, hopeful. The sphere fills about 69 percent of the card width, its centre sits at about 60 percent of the card height.
props.reject: The face of the REJECT vote card. The same warm cream parchment background, light and layout as its pair: the upper third calm and plain, left empty for a title to be added later. In the lower two thirds, centred: one perfectly round sphere of black obsidian, rough and craggy, with a cracked and faceted volcanic stone surface and a faint dull sheen on its edges, resting on the card and casting a soft shadow beneath it. Heavy, cold, final. The sphere is smaller than you would expect: it fills only about 58 percent of the card width, with wide empty parchment margins on the left and on the right, and its centre sits at about 60 percent of the card height.
props.success: The face of the SUCCESS quest card. Background: dark bronze with a fine brushed metallic texture, warm and softly glowing at the centre and darker toward the edges. The top fifth is calm and plain, left empty for a title to be added later. Centred: a tall golden chalice, the Holy Grail, polished and gleaming, with a deep rounded tulip shaped bowl engraved with a climbing vine pattern, a single thin row of small deep red stones near the rim, a slender stem with one round knot, and a wide domed foot. Warm golden light rises from inside the cup and catches the metal. The lower left and lower right areas beside the stem are calm and empty, left for two emblems to be added later. Triumphant, sacred, hopeful.
props.fail: The face of the FAIL quest card. The same dark bronze background and layout as its pair, but colder and dimmer, as if the light is dying. The top fifth is calm and plain, left empty for a title to be added later. Centred: the same tall chalice with a deep rounded tulip shaped bowl and engraved vine pattern, now tarnished and blackened, its gold dulled to dark brass with green black corrosion, a jagged crack running down the bowl, its small red stones dull like dried blood, and a thin curl of dark smoke rising from the empty cup. The lower right area beside the stem is calm and empty, left for one emblem to be added later. Ominous, betrayed, ruined.
props.lady_of_the_lake: The face of the Lady of the Lake card. A rich original oil painting with visible brush strokes, painterly fantasy, soft and luminous. A graceful woman seen from behind, standing waist deep in a still green and teal lake at dawn, her bare back and shoulders turned towards the viewer, long wavy golden hair falling down her back. She holds a thick, opaque, dry white linen shirt gathered against the front of her body and draped around her hips. The cloth is heavy and completely non transparent, not wet, not sheer, not see through, so nothing at the front or below the waist is visible through it. Her head is turned over her shoulder to look calmly at the viewer, serene knowing eyes, a faint mysterious smile. Pale green and teal water, soft mist low over the surface, white water lilies with round green pads floating near the lower left and lower right, soft pale gold dawn light from behind. The far shore is only forest and mist, with no buildings, no ruins and no castle anywhere. Modest, classical and elegant, in the manner of a classical painting. The picture fills the whole frame.
